question:
In the given figure, O is the centre of the circle and ∠AOB = 130°. Find ∠APB.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa6309977380ecf25909270fa63bb765c778d843048d68c904f875e745c548ff.png]
solution:
**Concept used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0825b74ebc62912f16ab591f53a15597c47b51566bda2787d16441d7a87cbaa1.png] 

According to the given picture, ∠AOB = 2∠ACB

Again, ∠ACB + ∠APB = 180°

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0825b74ebc62912f16ab591f53a15597c47b51566bda2787d16441d7a87cbaa1.png] 

According to the given concept,

∠AOB = 2∠ACB

⇒ ∠ACB = 130/2 = 65° 

Again, ∠ACB + ∠APB = 180°

⇒ ∠APB = 180° - 65° = 115°

∴ The correct answer is 115°
